h1.en: A Second Photograph Does Not Open a Second Electric Low Pressure 60 Concrete Pump Row
h1.zh: 第二张照片不会变成电动低压60型混凝土泵的第二行参数

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists the Electric Low Pressure 60 Concrete Pump at /products/electric-low-pressure-60-concrete-pump. This photograph is a separate factory picture of the same listed model. It does not print a second weight, a second output or a price. Copy the cells that page prints: Model Electric Low Pressure 60 / Electric 75-60; Motor Power 75 kW; Theoretical Output 35 m³/h; Max. Outlet Pressure 30 MPa; Hopper Capacity 0.5 m³; Fine Stone Conveying (H / V) 150 m / 350 m; 13 mm Stone (H / V) 100 m / 300 m; 24 mm Stone (H / V) 80 m / 240 m; Hydraulic Pump Kawasaki double pump 100; Dimensions (L×W×H) 4600 × 1700 × 1700 mm; Main Unit Weight 3500 kg. For transport, the page prints Dimensions (L×W×H) 4600 × 1700 × 1700 mm and Main Unit Weight 3500 kg. Hopper capacity is 0.5 m³. Theoretical output is printed as 35 m³/h. Send mix or material, maximum aggregate, the output you need, horizontal and vertical distance, diesel or the site voltage and frequency, country and purchase timing. The price is not on the page. Confirm the price with Xingtai at /contact. A related note in this set is /blog/buy-factory-hero-still-needs-a-model-path.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把电动低压60型混凝土泵列在 /products/electric-low-pressure-60-concrete-pump。 这张照片是同一已列型号的另一张工厂图片。它不另印重量、不另印输送量，也不印价格。抄该页已印的格子：型号 Electric Low Pressure 60 / Electric 75-60、电机功率 75 kW、理论输送量 35 m³/h、最大出口压力 30 MPa、料斗容积 0.5 m³、细石输送（水平/垂直） 150 m / 350 m、13 mm石子（水平/垂直） 100 m / 300 m、24 mm石子（水平/垂直） 80 m / 240 m、液压泵 Kawasaki double pump 100、外形尺寸 4600 × 1700 × 1700 mm、整机重量 3500 kg。运输一栏，页面印的是外形尺寸 4600 × 1700 × 1700 mm，以及整机重量 3500 kg。料斗容积是 0.5 m³。理论输送量印的是 35 m³/h。同时发送材料或配合比、最大骨料、需要的输送量、水平与垂直距离、柴油或现场电压和频率、国家与采购时间。页面上没有价格。价格向邢台询盘确认，用 /contact。本批相关说明见 /blog/buy-factory-hero-still-needs-a-model-path。

heading.en: What to copy from this page

body.en: Name /products/electric-low-pressure-60-concrete-pump in the subject line. The published row is: Model Electric Low Pressure 60 / Electric 75-60; Motor Power 75 kW; Theoretical Output 35 m³/h; Max. Outlet Pressure 30 MPa; Hopper Capacity 0.5 m³; Fine Stone Conveying (H / V) 150 m / 350 m; 13 mm Stone (H / V) 100 m / 300 m; 24 mm Stone (H / V) 80 m / 240 m; Hydraulic Pump Kawasaki double pump 100; Dimensions (L×W×H) 4600 × 1700 × 1700 mm; Main Unit Weight 3500 kg. For transport, the page prints Dimensions (L×W×H) 4600 × 1700 × 1700 mm and Main Unit Weight 3500 kg. Leave any cell the page does not print empty.
body.zh: 主题里写上 /products/electric-low-pressure-60-concrete-pump。已公布的一行是：型号 Electric Low Pressure 60 / Electric 75-60、电机功率 75 kW、理论输送量 35 m³/h、最大出口压力 30 MPa、料斗容积 0.5 m³、细石输送（水平/垂直） 150 m / 350 m、13 mm石子（水平/垂直） 100 m / 300 m、24 mm石子（水平/垂直） 80 m / 240 m、液压泵 Kawasaki double pump 100、外形尺寸 4600 × 1700 × 1700 mm、整机重量 3500 kg。运输一栏，页面印的是外形尺寸 4600 × 1700 × 1700 mm，以及整机重量 3500 kg。页面没有印的格子保持空白。

heading.en: Power and line size on the same note
heading.zh: 同一封里的动力和管路

body.en: Motor power on this page is 75 kW. The page does not print a voltage cell, so the inquiry still carries the site voltage and frequency. Do not invent a voltage. This page does not print a delivery-pipe diameter. Leave that cell blank on the order and confirm the size with Xingtai if the job needs pipe.
body.zh: 这一页的电机功率是 75 kW。页面没有电压格，所以询盘仍要带上现场电压和频率。不要自填电压。这一页没有印输送管径。订单上这一格留空；如果工程要配管子，向邢台确认尺寸。

body.en: Confirm the price with Xingtai. The page does not print a list price, a production-day count, a certificate name or a list of export countries. Equipment on these pages ships from Xingtai. The category answers do not claim an overseas warehouse. Write to /contact, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Another page in this set is /blog/buy-factory-hero-still-needs-a-model-path.
body.zh: 价格向邢台询盘确认。页面不印标价、不印生产天数、不印证书名称，也不印出口国名单。这些页面上的设备从邢台发货。分类说明不声称有海外仓。写信到 /contact、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。本批另一篇是 /blog/buy-factory-hero-still-needs-a-model-path。

answer.en: It is not printed on the Electric Low Pressure 60 Concrete Pump page. Confirm the price with Xingtai.
answer.zh: 电动低压60型混凝土泵页面上没有印价格。价格向邢台询盘确认。

question.en: Which address do I put on the inquiry?

answer.en: Put /products/electric-low-pressure-60-concrete-pump. That path selects this row. The contact page is /contact.
answer.zh: 写上 /products/electric-low-pressure-60-concrete-pump。这条路径选定这一行。联系页是 /contact。

question.en: What weight do I give the forwarder?

answer.en: For transport, the page prints Dimensions (L×W×H) 4600 × 1700 × 1700 mm and Main Unit Weight 3500 kg.
answer.zh: 运输一栏，页面印的是外形尺寸 4600 × 1700 × 1700 mm，以及整机重量 3500 kg。

question.en: Can I add a certificate or a delivery date?
question.zh: 可以补上证书或交货日期吗？

answer.en: The page does not print a certificate name or a production-day count. Ask Xingtai in the same inquiry, and do not fill those cells yourself.
answer.zh: 页面没有印证书名称，也没有印生产天数。在同一封询盘里问邢台，不要自己填这些格子。

question.en: Which hopper volume is on this row?
question.zh: 这一行的料斗容积是多少？

answer.en: The page prints 0.5 m³. Use that figure with /products/electric-low-pressure-60-concrete-pump.
answer.zh: 页面印的是 0.5 m³。与 /products/electric-low-pressure-60-concrete-pump 一起使用这个数字。
